paragraphs: He reports Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish: Shabbat 75b.[^1]

notes.text: The abbreviation ארש״בל is read here as reporting Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish. The stored William Davidson Edition, Shabbat 75b, explicitly has Rabbi Shimon ben Kisma reporting Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish, supporting both title expansions in this occurrence. This is digital-edition evidence, without printed-page or universal identity adjudication.
